zh.title: 空中巴士獲兩家醫療運輸商分別增訂5架H135與3架H145
zh.summary: 兩家醫療運輸商分別增訂5架H135與3架H145
body: 空中巴士於2026年10月26日至27日在德克薩斯州沃斯堡分別與Life Flight Network和Boston MedFlight簽署新訂單。
Life Flight Network在10月26日的航空醫療運輸會議（AMTC）上確認增購五架H135直升機，這筆訂單承接2025年訂購的三架H135，使其H135累計訂單達八架。
Boston MedFlight則在10月27日宣佈再購三架H145直升機，將其H145累計採購量提升至十二架，以支援新英格蘭地區的重症轉運任務。
兩款機型均配備空中巴士Helionix航電套件與四軸自動駕駛，具備低噪音、高可靠性與先進安全技術，適合在複雜氣象與地形條件下執行醫療後送任務。

en.title: Airbus secures H135 order from Life Flight Network and H145 order from Boston MedFlight
en.summary: Life Flight Network orders five H135s; Boston MedFlight orders three H145s
body: Airbus announced two new orders on 26‑27 October 2026 at Fort Worth, Texas, with Life Flight Network and Boston MedFlight.

Life Flight Network confirmed an order for five H135 helicopters on 26 October during the Air Medical Transport Conference, building on a 2025 order for three H135s and bringing its total H135 commitments to eight.
Boston MedFlight announced on 27 October the purchase of three H145 helicopters, raising its cumulative H145 fleet to twelve aircraft to support critical‑care transport across New England.
Both the H135 and H145 feature Airbus Helionix avionics, a four‑axis autopilot, low acoustic footprint and advanced safety systems suited for demanding medical‑evacuation missions.

facts.claim: Life Flight Network placed an order for five Airbus H135 helicopters on 26 October 2026 at Fort Worth, Texas.
facts.sourceQuote: Fort Worth, Texas, 26 October 2026 – Life Flight Network has placed an order for five Airbus H135 helicopters

facts.claim: The new H135 order builds on a 2025 order for three H135s, bringing Life Flight Network's total H135 orders to eight.
facts.sourceQuote: These new aircraft will build on their order for three new H135s placed in 2025, bringing their total number aircraft ordered to eight.

facts.claim: Boston MedFlight placed an order for three Airbus H145 helicopters on 27 October 2026 at Fort Worth, Texas.
facts.sourceQuote: Fort Worth, Texas, 27 October 2026 – Boston MedFlight, the globally recognized nonprofit critical care transport organization, has placed an order with Airbus Helicopters for the purchase of three H145 helicopters

facts.claim: The H145 order raises Boston MedFlight's total H145 purchases to twelve.
facts.sourceQuote: The order brings the total number of Airbus H145 helicopters purchased by the organization over time to 12.
